excluded_external_inputs.reason: Exact current CLI is a pinned external executable; the accepted build receipt/raw provenance are retained without the executable payload.

notes: Every explicit input root is required; a missing root or declared exclusion is a hard failure.
Every explicitly excluded CLI copy matches the matrix current CLI bytes/SHA-256 and has its own pinned mode.
The exact matrix current CLI path is excluded exactly once; other excluded paths are byte-equivalent copies only.
All other files, including failed captures and review artifacts, are payload.
